sentences.text: No: for a floating-rate business loan to an MSE sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges.

The bank’s own loan policy states 2% or 3% pre-payment charge in its home-loan wording, but the applicable UCB directions for this case prohibit such a charge, so that policy wording does not govern this loan.
